title: Heritage Hill State Historical Park

services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: Bring your students on a journey to the past where they can make connections to their present! Experience daily life in Wisconsin from the 17th - 20th centuries with knowledgeable historical interpreters and hands-on, inquiry-based learning. Field trips are offered May - October, Tuesday - Friday, 9 a.m. - 3 p.m. Every journey begins with good planning. Here’s what you need to know to plan your Heritage Hill field trip: Field trips are self-guided so you can explore Heritage Hill at your own pace. services.name: Private Events
services.desc: Heritage Hill is one of the area’s most unique wedding venues, set on 56 acres of beautifully preserved parkland with 27 historic buildings creating a truly immersive backdrop. Choose from several stunning ceremony and reception locations. We offer full-day wedding experiences with two flexible reception packages, featuring both indoor and outdoor options-allowing couples to celebrate their entire day in one unforgettable location. services.name: Hours & Daily Admission
services.desc: Every Thursday at 1 pm - take a 60 minute guided tour of the Park on our ADA accessible tram. The tour will not stop at buildings, but you will have the opportunity to visit with the historic interpreters before or after the tour. Tram tours are $20 per person. The historic buildings will be closed but the park will be open for walking, snowshoeing, sledding, etc. Please note, not all paths are groomed. Wear appropriate gear and plan accordingly. Leashed dogs are always welcome!
